levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: «قيل لسفيان فإن معمرا يحدثه ...» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route (rule 4)
Sufyan's answer («ما سمعت الزهري يقول إلا عن عبيد الله ...») repeats the main route and is left out
«ميمونة» relays the saying (the Companion as last link); the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link
